text_block_list.text:
December, with the Senior Class fast approaching.
Taking advantage of a break from training, todayâ
—We came all the way to the ocean to fish.
Around this same time last year, I took Cheval Grand out to set her goals for the following year.

In the end, that special outing back then was
meaningless, but—this year will be different.

We share the broad goal of challenging Kitasan Black.
Perhaps thanks to the familiar surroundings,
Cheval Grand's expression looks bright as well.
choice_data_list: You're pretty used to fishing, huh.
You're pretty used to fishing, aren't you.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um, during winter breaks and such...
My dad would often take me.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"At home, Dad and I are the only ones
who like fishing... so it made me really happy—"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —Ah.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Y-You're creeping me out, Trainer...!
choice_data_list: Huh? What am I supposed to do with this!?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... G-Get the landing net...!
No, raise the rod first—... Aaargh!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry,
I wasn't able to back you up properly...

Startled by the sudden bite, I let the fish get away.
So far, my catch count stands at zero.

Meanwhile, Cheval Grand has
already reeled in several fish.
I never imagined there would be such a gap in skill—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: T-Too bad...
choice_data_list: You really are more skilled than me after all.
You really are more skilled than me after all.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh. N-No way... Not someone like me.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I... It must be my constitution...?
Or something like that...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I have no presence, so...
I thought the fish... might let their guard down too...
choice_data_list: Erasing your presence like that—are you a master or something?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-No, no, no, that's not it...!
It's just that I'm plain and unremarkable, that's all!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Also... I'm really good at staying super quiet
a-and not moving at all... so—
Then, one of the anglers who had been watching us for a while chuckled heartily and spoke up.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan Angler
text_block_list.text:
—Even so, when it comes to reeling it in at the end,
you need guts and decisive action!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan Angler
text_block_list.text: "I've been watching for a while, and if anything, little lady, your timing when you make a move is brilliant—wait."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan Angler
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Aren't you
that girl who's been running in the
Twinkle Series lately?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan Angler
text_block_list.text: Look, I knew it! I thought to myself that there was a runner out there with a remarkably mature, great stride!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan Angler
text_block_list.text:
Is that so! You're into fishing too, huh!
Well now, I'll definitely have to cheer for you in your races!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan Angler
text_block_list.text:
I won't let anyone call you plain.
I'll cheer for you so loud that everyone's eyes will be on you!

The excitement must have really taken over.
The angler's boisterous enthusiasm catches me off guard.

Cheval Grand isn't very good with crowds and noise.
Just as I was worrying that she might be scared—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Th-Th-Thank you very much...
I-I-I, I—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Guh..., mmghhh.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll do my best...!
Um......... b-both in the race, and fishing.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan Angler
text_block_list.text: Oh-ho, looking good! I'm cheering for you!

After thoroughly enjoying our fishing trip,
I take a stroll along the shore with Cheval Grand.

Her fishing skills were impressive, but above all,
I was moved that she was able to talk to a fan who suddenly approached her
without running away.

"Perhaps running in so many graded stakes
and getting results during the Classic tier
gave her this confidence."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: N-No, someone like me... not at all...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Still... it made me happy.
Knowing that there's someone who knows about my races..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
By the way, um...
Trainer, to-today is...

"...That's right.
I was fishing to relax, but ended up
having a little too much fun with it."
"Today's original objective was to set our goals for the Senior Class. That being said—"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: The Hanshin Daishoten...?

The race I proposed was a GII held at
Hanshin Racecourse in March of the new year.

It's a long distance of 3,000m and a tough race with top contenders from the Senior class gathered,
but with your current ability, you can definitely aim for victory.

"Besides, using this race as a stepping stone,
there's another race I want Cheval Grand to take on."
choice_data_list: From there, let's aim for the Tenno Sho (Spring)!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring).........
Does that mean, perhaps...
choice_data_list: Because Kitasan Black is sure to run too.

text_block_list.text:
I came up with this rotation to grant
the wish Cheval Grand told me
on our way back from the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I want to believe that I'm strong too...,
that I have a strength all my own.
That's why—
"In that case, there's only one thing to do."
"In that case, there's only one thing to do, right?"
“Let's challenge Kitasan Black!”

At 3,200 meters, the Tenno Sho (Spring) is
the longest GI race held in the Twinkle Series.

To face Kitasan Black here,
I want to get used to longer distances
and build up momentum before taking on the race. That's why—
choice_data_list: The "Hanshin Daishoten"... We will definitely win.

text_block_list.text: In the past, I wouldn't have been able to use strong words like "without fail" with Cheval Grand.
Yet now, Cheval Grand has grown to the point where she can openly declare her desire to become stronger and fix her sights on her rivals.

You can definitely do it.
I want you to believe in yourself, believe that you can—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I'll do it.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"The Hanshin Daishoten... I will definitely win it...
Because I want to challenge Kita-san... with my head held high..."
As Cheval Grand voiced her resolve, a strong light shone in her eyes.

So as not to let the fire of that resolve die out,
I swore to give everything in the Hanshin Daishoten—
